dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep, concave curvature with the spline following a sharp inward arc from the apex down to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a smooth curvature at the highest morphological point; absence of acute or hooked termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays a steep, slightly convex slope measured at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.3 times the maximum vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of pale, linear and irregular depigmented markings across the lateral body surface and at the base of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly mottled integument pattern characterized by high-contrast light-colored splotches distributed across the visible dark-grey epidermis.
